data.name: Dany's Terrain Sandbox
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Dany's Terrain Sandbox! 

Here you can build your dream terrain and view it in real-time. This is a place for graphics programmers, students, or anyone who thinks math is beautiful to play with the raw algorithms that shape digital landscapes. You get to sit in the driver's seat of the generation and see exactly what happens when you change one of the 13 variables that control the terrain.

The terrain is powered by Perlin Noise, Fractal Brownian Motion (fBm), and Multi Fractal Ridge Noise. 

If you have any questions, comments, or would like to chat about this project feel free to reach out!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent (3.0 GHz+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX11 support i.e. NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660, AMD Radeon HD 7870, or modern Intel UHD Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (or similar modern 64-bit distribution)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent (3.0 GHz+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-capable GPU with support for OpenGL 3.2+ (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
